nodes.name: 📧 Normalize Incoming Email

v7: checks staticData for existing conversationId.
New email → isFollowUp=false → new Slack card.
Customer reply → isFollowUp=true → Slack thread reply.
Always returns 1 item with shouldPost + skipReason + isFollowUp.

FALSE → dead end. Check skipReason in Normalize output.

nodes.name: 🔀 New or Follow-up?
nodes.notes:
TRUE (follow-up) → 📩 Post Follow-up to Slack Thread.
FALSE (new email) → 💬 Post Request to Slack → 🧷 Store Mapping.
